metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in Palm Springs, California higher on July 15-21, 2017 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS LST products (MOD11A2 or MOD11A1) for both periods - Location: Palm Springs, California (~33.8303°N, 116.5453°W) - Compare July 15-21, 2017 vs July 15-21 average for 2001-2010 - MOD11A1 provides daily LST, MOD11A2 is 8-day composite 2. Masking strategy: - Use QA bands to mask poor quality LST pixels - LST data comes in Kelvin * 0.02 scale factor, need to convert to Celsius 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check collection sizes for both periods - Verify pixel counts after masking - LST should be in reasonable range (e.g., -50°C to 70°C for summer) - Compare: if 2017 > historical average, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define location and time periods const palmSprings = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.5453, 33.8303]); const region = palmSprings.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer const target_start = '2017-07-15'; const target_end = '2017-07-22'; // 2. Function to get LST in Celsius with QA masking function processLST(image) { const lst = image.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // Convert to Celsius const qa = image.select('QA_Day'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1); // Keep only good quality (bits 0-1 <= 1) return lst.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Get 2017 data let col2017 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterDate(target_start, target_end) .filterBounds(palmSprings) .map(processLST); const size2017 = col2017.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2017 Images: ${size2017}`); if (size2017 === 0) { console.log("No data for 2017 period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Get historical average (2001-2010, same days) const years = ee.List.sequence(2001, 2010); const historicalImages = years.map(function(year) { const y = ee.Number(year).format('%d'); const start = ee.String(y).cat('-07-15'); const end = ee.String(y).cat('-07-22'); return ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(palmSprings) .map(processLST) .mean(); }); const historicalCol = ee.ImageCollection(historicalImages); const sizeHistorical = historicalCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Historical years with data: ${sizeHistorical}`); if (sizeHistorical === 0) { console.log("No historical data found."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 5. Calculate means const mean2017 = col2017.mean(); const meanHistorical = historicalCol.mean(); // 6. Extract values with pixel count check const stats2017 = mean2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const statsHistorical = meanHistorical.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const lst2017 = stats2017.LST_Day_1km_mean; const count2017 = stats2017.LST_Day_1km_count; const lstHistorical = statsHistorical.LST_Day_1km_mean; const countHistorical = statsHistorical.LST_Day_1km_count; console.log(`2017 LST: ${lst2017 !== null ? lst2017.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C, Pixels: ${count2017 || 0}`); console.log(`Historical LST: ${lstHistorical !== null ? lstHistorical.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C, Pixels: ${countHistorical || 0}`); // 7. Validation and final answer if (count2017 === 0 || countHistorical === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (lst2017 === null || lstHistorical === null || lst2017 < -50 || lst2017 > 70 || lstHistorical < -50 || lstHistorical > 70) { console.log("Invalid LST values."); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Difference: ${(lst2017 - lstHistorical).toFixed(2)}°C`); if (lst2017 > lstHistorical) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
